<!-- pr-reviewer: fddf5300f0e8b2eb481eeece6c7d850a366c3617 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The example meets #2863. The saved project contains all four operation kinds and embeds the plate mesh without a source link. The script uses existing commands. No production code, dependency, process file, or UI code changes.

Results locally, after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at `bac4a96c7244eda3cd1341b8131b8f0c6d1cd67f`:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all three steps passed. The build used `--no-run` for both app suites.
- `example_catalog`: 5 passed. All cases regenerate, verify, post byte for byte, and rebuild from their scripts.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- `cargo xtask catalog --check`: all five cases passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: no heavy lane reached.

Extra suites run:

- The fixture search found `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, and `catalog_render`.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test catalog_render`, from `crates/ui`: 1 passed, 1 ignored. The ignored test is the screenshot renderer.
- The PR adds no STEP fixture and changes no importer code. The extra kernel importer suites do not apply.

Safety review:

- I checked all 77 lines of the added NC file. No existing golden changes. Tool selection, feeds, clearance moves, cutting depths, and closed paths agree with the script and saved project.
- The cutting depths are Z5.2 for Chamfer, Z5.7 for Deburr, and Z5.8 for Engrave and Trace.
- I changed the Chamfer section header locally. The pin failed with `missing Chamfer section`. It passed after restoration.
- I changed the Deburr section header locally. The pin failed with `missing Deburr section`. It passed after restoration.
- The worktree is clean after restoration. No physical machine run or GUI inspection was performed.

Requested before merge: none.

The initial compile cache attempt stalled and reported cache write errors. I stopped that attempt and completed all checks with the cache disabled. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Merge class: SAME (no commit after the reviewed head). This merge relies on the review by mkinney with the marker for head `fddf5300f0e8b2eb481eeece6c7d850a366c3617`.
